+# .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml — the guard origin map (cycle-129 SDD D-1.1, §3.1).

+# markers in validate-artifact.sh) and fails (exit 5) when one has no row here, when a
+# row here resolves to nothing, or when a row's origin is empty. It then writes the
+# tracked structural register grimoires/loa/guards.md and the untracked host yield
+# .run/guard-yield.{md,json}. Regenerate after editing: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table
+#
+# Row fields:
+#   id             hook:<path under .claude/hooks> (scripts outside it: hook:scripts/<name>),
+#                  fence:<pattern id>, validator:<type>.<rule>, gate:<name>, policy:<name>;
+#                  ^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$
+#   kind           hook | fence | validator | gate | policy
+#   class          harness (the model cannot override it) | script (a script checks or
+#                  reports) | prose (the model is asked to comply)
+#   status         active | dormant (armed only by the env var named in knob) |
+#                  telemetry (observes and logs, never refuses)
+#   origin         {kind: kf|issue|finding|cycle|design, ref: <non-empty>}; design rows
+#                  cite the commit that added the guard (git log --follow --diff-filter=A)
+#   knob           the config key or env var that arms, relaxes or disables it, or none
+#   floor          true exactly for the ids in .claude/data/floor.yaml floor_guards
+#   registrations  hook rows: every "<Event>:<matcher>" (or "<Event>" when the
+#                  registration has no matcher) from .claude/settings.json; [] otherwise
+#   script         gate and policy rows: the file that implements it (must exist)
+#   note           one line; the hooks-reference table's Purpose column for hook rows
+schema_version: 1

+  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks
+  - id: hook:scripts/upgrade-health-check.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v1.5.0 692aa617"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["Setup"]
+    note: "Post-install and post-upgrade health check of the framework mount"
+  - id: hook:scripts/check-updates.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v0.14.0 1f448140"}
+    knob: update_check.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Notify when a newer framework release exists (cached; LOA_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 silences it)"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-l6-surface-handoffs.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-098 FR-L6 (#771)"}
+    knob: structured_handoff.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Surface unread L6 structured handoffs inside a data fence"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-l7-surface-soul.sh

+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-098 FR-L7"}
+    knob: soul_identity_doc.enabled

+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Surface the L7 soul identity document inside a data fence"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-run-mode-session-title.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-114 FR-9"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Set the session title from the run-mode state for recovery"
+  - id: hook:loa-kf-surface.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-115"}
+    knob: known_failures.surface_at_session_start
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Print the known-failures symptom table at session start (default off)"
+  - id: hook:hook-guard.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: issue, ref: "#1180"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart", "PreToolUse:Bash", "PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit", "PreToolUse:Skill"]
+    note: "Parse-guard wrapper: runs bash -n on the wrapped hook and fails a broken one open instead of bricking the tool"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-decisions-surface.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-128"}
+    knob: decisions.surface_at_session_start
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Default off: up to ten proposed or open decision rows inside the L6 data fence, plus a stale unattended-marker notice"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-run-state-surface.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-125 FR-3"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "One Run line when a run is HALTED or INTERRUPTED or RUNNING idle 12h+, plus a session-limit-reset line; silent otherwise"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-context-class.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-126 FR-3.1"}
+    knob: LOA_CONTEXT_CLASS
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Write .run/context-class (long by default, standard for a 200K-or-less model) for the context-discipline thresholds; silent, never blocks"
+  - id: hook:pre-compact-marker.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v1.28.0 dd8f6bf4 (#181)"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreCompact"]
+    note: "Save a marker before compaction"
+  - id: hook:post-compact-reminder.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v1.28.0 dd8f6bf4 (#181)"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["UserPromptSubmit"]
+    note: "Inject the recovery reminder after compaction"
+  - id: hook:post-session-limit-reminder.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: issue, ref: "#1177"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["UserPromptSubmit"]
+    note: "Inject the resume reminder after a session cap resets"
+  - id: hook:scripts/cleanup-context.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v0.19.0 b10450fa"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Skill(plan-and-analyze.*)"]
+    note: "Archive the previous cycle's discovery context before /plan-and-analyze"
+  - id: hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-011"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Bash"]
+    note: "Block destructive commands and System-Zone shell writes (the fence; per-pattern rows are fence:<id>)"
+  - id: hook:safety/team-role-guard.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: dormant
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-020 (#337)"}
+    knob: LOA_TEAM_MEMBER
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Bash"]
+    note: "Enforce lead-only operations in Agent Teams (armed only when LOA_TEAM_MEMBER is set)"
+  - id: hook:safety/team-role-guard-write.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: dormant
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-020 (#337)"}
+    knob: LOA_TEAM_MEMBER
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"]
+    note: "Block teammate writes to the System Zone, state files and append-only files (armed only when LOA_TEAM_MEMBER is set)"
+  - id: hook:safety/spiral-dispatch-guard.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-072"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"]
+    note: "Block inline implementation writes under /spiraling until spiral-harness.sh is dispatched"
+  - id: hook:safety/zone-write-guard.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-106"}
+    knob: LOA_ZONE_GUARD_DISABLE
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"]
+    note: "Block project-work writes into the framework zone (bounded marker .run/zone-guard-authorization.json for framework development)"
+  - id: hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-050 FR-7"}
+    knob: implement_gate.mode
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"]
+    note: "ADVISORY: ask on an App Zone write outside an active implementation run, on a write to the gate's own trust inputs, and when the write cannot be evaluated; never blocks"
+  - id: hook:safety/notes-size-guard.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-124 FR-10"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"]
+    note: "Refuse a write that would grow grimoires/loa/NOTES.md at or over 200 KiB (shrinking edits and notes-guard.sh rotate pass)"
+  - id: hook:safety/adversarial-review-gate.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: issue, ref: "#552"}
+    knob: flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"]
+    note: "Block a COMPLETED marker write when cross-model dissent is enabled and its artefact is missing or invalid (the floor row is gate:adversarial-review-gate)"
+  - id: hook:safety/team-skill-guard.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: dormant
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-020 (#337)"}
+    knob: LOA_TEAM_MEMBER
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Skill"]
+    note: "Block lead-only skill invocations for teammates (armed only when LOA_TEAM_MEMBER is set)"
+  - id: hook:safety/spiral-skill-sentinel.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "cycle-072 598a88ee"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreToolUse:Skill"]
+    note: "Write the spiral sentinel when /spiraling is invoked so the dispatch guard arms itself"
+  - id: hook:audit/mutation-logger.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: telemetry
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-011"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PostToolUse:Bash"]
+    note: "Log mutating shell commands to .run/audit.jsonl"
+  - id: hook:audit/write-mutation-logger.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: telemetry
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-020 (#337)"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PostToolUse:Write", "PostToolUse:Edit"]
+    note: "Log Write and Edit tool file modifications to .run/audit.jsonl"
+  - id: hook:quality/karpathy-surgical-diff-check.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: telemetry
+    origin: {kind: issue, ref: "#961"}
+    knob: karpathy_principles.surgical_diff_warning

+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-011"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false

+#   status         active | dormant (armed only by the env var named in knob) |
+#                  telemetry (observes and logs, never refuses)

+#                  cite the commit that added the guard (git log --follow --diff-filter=A)
+#   knob           the config key or env var that arms, relaxes or disables it, or none
+#   floor          true exactly for the ids in .claude/data/floor.yaml floor_guards
+#   registrations  hook rows: every "<Event>:<matcher>" (or "<Event>" when the
+#                  registration has no matcher) from .claude/settings.json; [] otherwise
+#   script         gate and policy rows: the file that implements it (must exist)
+#   note           one line; the hooks-reference table's Purpose column for hook rows

+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-098 FR-L6 (#771)"}

+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]

+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-l7-surface-soul.sh

+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-115"}

+    floor: false

+    floor: false

#!/usr/bin/env bash # ============================================================================= # guard-yield.sh — the guard register and its 30-day host yield (cycle-129 FR-1) # ============================================================================= # Enumerates every guard Loa ships and joins it with its origin and its yield: # hooks every command registered in .claude/settings.json, parsed against # the canonical schema "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"/.claude/ [args] # (or the same wrapped in hook-guard.sh); one row per unique script # fences the `# @guard fence:` markers in block-destructive-bash.sh, # cross-checked both ways against its emit_block call sites and # its literal `pattern_id: ""` audit constants # validators the `# @guard validator:` markers in validate-artifact.sh # gates the fixed list in the origin map (each row's `script` must exist) # policies the floor policies in the origin map # Origins, class, status, knob and floor come from .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml; # the floor set must equal .claude/data/floor.yaml floor_guards. # # Outputs: # grimoires/loa/guards.md tracked, STRUCTURAL ONLY (a pure function of the # repository; no timestamp, no yield) — --check gates it # .run/guard-yield.md, .json untracked host yield: blocks_30d, likely_fp_30d, # telemetry_30d, last_real_catch per guard # hooks-reference.md table with --hooks-table, the rows between # and # # Yield (SDD D-1.3): rows of .run/audit.jsonl and its rotated segments # .run/audit.jsonl.* with action == "block", plus implement-gate rows (telemetry # when action is telemetry or ask), with ts inside the window. if [[ -L "$abs" ]]; then
        tgt="$(readlink "$abs")"
        case "$tgt" in /*) ;; *) tgt="$(dirname "$abs")/$tgt" ;; esac
        tdir="$(cd "$(dirname "$tgt")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || tdir=""
        canon="$tdir/$(basename "$tgt")"
        case "$canon" in
            "$ROOT/.claude/"*) rel="${canon#"$ROOT/.claude/"}"; abs="$canon" ;;
            *) echo "hook script .claude/$rel is a symlink that leaves .claude/ (registered for $ev)" >> "$ERRORS"; continue ;;
        esac
    fi
    if [[ ! -f "$abs" ]]; then
        echo "hook script .claude/$rel registered for $ev does not exist" >> "$ERRORS"
        continue
    fi
    case "$rel" in hooks/*) id="hook:${rel#hooks/}" ;; *) id="hook:$rel" ;; esac
    if [[ -n "$mt" ]]; then reg="$ev:$mt"; else reg="$ev"; fi
    jq -cn --arg id "$id" --arg rel "$rel" --arg ev "$ev" --arg mt "$mt" --arg reg "$reg" --arg w "$wrapped" \
        '{id: $id, rel: $rel, event: $ev, matcher: $mt, registration: $reg, wrapped: ($w == "1")}' >> "$HOOK_ROWS"
done < "$HOOK_LINES"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- fence markers
# Sites: `emit_block "<ID>"` calls and literal `pattern_id: "<ID>"` audit constants on
# non-comment lines. Each site needs a marker with its id within the 8 lines above;
# each marker needs a site with its id within the 8 lines below.
FENCE_IDS="$TMPWORK/fence.ids"
awk -v errs="$ERRORS" '
  function note(s) { print s >> errs }
  /^[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*@guard[[:space:]]+fence:/ {
    s = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*@guard[[:space:]]+fence:/, "", s); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", s)
    if (s !~ /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/) { note("fence marker at line " NR " has an invalid id"); next }
    nm++; mline[nm] = NR; mid[nm] = s; next
  }
  /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
  {
    line = $0
    if (line ~ /emit_block[[:space:]]*\(\)/) next
    while (match(line, /emit_block[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+/)) {
      tok = substr(line, RSTART, RLENGTH); line = substr(line, RSTART + RLENGTH)
      sub(/^emit_block[[:space:]]+/, "", tok)
      if (tok ~ /^"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"$/) { gsub(/"/, "", tok); ns++; sline[ns] = NR; sid[ns] = tok }
      else note("fence emit_block call at line " NR " has a non-literal pattern id; give it a literal id and a # @guard fence:<id> marker")
    }
    line = $0
    while (match(line, /pattern_id(: |=)"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"/)) {
      tok = substr(line, RSTART, RLENGTH); line = substr(line, RSTART + RLENGTH)
      sub(/^pattern_id(: |=)"/, "", tok); sub(/"$/, "", tok)
      ns++; sline[ns] = NR; sid[ns] = tok
    }
  }
  END {
    for (i = 1; i <= ns; i++) {
      ok = 0
      for (j = 1; j <= nm; j++) if (mid[j] == sid[i] && mline[j] < sline[i] && sline[i] - mline[j] <= 8) ok = 1
      if (!ok) note("fence site " sid[i] " at line " sline[i] " has no # @guard fence:" sid[i] " marker within the 8 lines above it")
    }
    for (j = 1; j <= nm; j++) {
      ok = 0
      for (i = 1; i <= ns; i++) if (mid[j] == sid[i] && mline[j] < sline[i] && sline[i] - mline[j] <= 8) ok = 1
      if (!ok) note("fence marker " mid[j] " at line " mline[j] " has no emit_block or pattern_id site with that id within the 8 lines below it")
      print mid[j]
    }
  }
' "$FENCE" | sort -u > "$FENCE_IDS"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- validator markers
VALIDATOR_IDS="$TMPWORK/validator.ids"
awk -v errs="$ERRORS" '
  /^[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*@guard[[:space:]]+validator:/ {

    if (s !~ /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/) { print "validator marker at line " NR " has an invalid id" >> errs; next }
    if (s in seen) { print "validator marker " s " appears twice (lines " seen[s] " and " NR ")" >> errs; next }
    seen[s] = NR; print s
  }
' "$VALIDATOR" | sort -u > "$VALIDATOR_IDS"

  | {

              | group_by(.id) | map({id: .[0].id, registrations: (map(.registration) | unique)})),

jq -r --argjson e "$ENUM_JSON" --argjson floor "$FLOOR_JSON" --argjson gates "$GATE_LIST" --argjson policies "$POLICY_LIST" --arg map "$ORIGINS" '

  | ($e.hooks | map(.id)) as $hooks | $e.fences as $fences | $e.validators as $validators
  | (($hooks + $fences + $validators)[] | select($by[.] == null) | "guard \(.) has no origin row in \($map)"),
    ($g[] | select(.kind == "hook") | select(.id | IN($hooks[]) | not) | "row \(.id) resolves to nothing: no command in .claude/settings.json runs that script"),

    ($e.hooks[] | . as $h | $by[$h.id] // empty | select(((.registrations // []) | unique) != $h.registrations)
      | "row \($h.id) registrations \((.registrations // []) | unique | tojson) differ from .claude/settings.json \($h.registrations | tojson)"),
    (($gates + $policies)[] | select($by[.] == null) | "required row \(.) is missing from \($map)"),
    ((($floor.floor_guards // []) | if type != "array" then ["(floor_guards is not a list)"] else . end) as $fg
      | ($fg[] | select($by[.] == null) | "floor guard \(.) has no row in \($map)"),
        ($g[] | select(.floor == true) | select(.id | IN($fg[]) | not) | "row \(.id) has floor: true but is not in floor.yaml floor_guards"),
        ($g[] | select(.floor != true) | select(.id | IN($fg[])) | "row \(.id) is in floor.yaml floor_guards but has floor: false"))

while IFS= read -r spath; do

    [[ -f "$ROOT/$spath" ]] || echo "gate or policy script $spath does not exist" >> "$ERRORS"
done < <(jq -r '.guards[] | select(.kind == "gate" or .kind == "policy") | .script' <<<"$MAP_JSON")

if [[ -s "$ERRORS" ]]; then
    sed "s/^/$SCRIPT_NAME: /" "$ERRORS" >&2
    exit 5
fi

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- renderers
# Shared cell sanitiser: control characters removed, pipes escaped for GFM tables.
JQ_DEFS='
  def cell: tostring | explode | map(select(. >= 32 and . != 127)) | implode | gsub("\\|"; "\\|");
  def kinds: ["hook", "fence", "validator", "gate", "policy"];
  def regs: if (.registrations // []) | length == 0 then "-" else (.registrations | map("`" + cell + "`") | join(", ")) end;
  def origin_txt: .origin as $o | if ($o.ref | tostring | startswith($o.kind | tostring)) then ($o.ref | tostring) else "\($o.kind) \($o.ref)" end;
  def yesno: if . == true then "yes" else "no" end;
'

render_register() {
    jq -r "$JQ_DEFS"'
      .guards as $g
      | "# Guard register",
        "",
        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh from .claude/settings.json, the fence and validator markers and .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml. Do not edit by hand: edit the origin map and regenerate (.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table); CI runs --check. -->",
        "",
        "Every guard Loa ships, with its class, status, origin, knob and floor flag. Structural only: the 30-day yield of a host is untracked, in `.run/guard-yield.md` and `.run/guard-yield.json` (regenerate with `.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh`). Classes: harness (the model cannot override it), script (a script checks or reports), prose (the model is asked to comply). Status: dormant means armed only by the env var in the knob column; telemetry means it observes and never refuses.",
        "",
        "- guards: \($g | length)",
        "- guards_without_origin: \($g | map(select((.origin.ref // "") == "")) | length)",
        "- dormant: \($g | map(select(.status == "dormant")) | length)",
        "- floor: \($g | map(select(.floor == true)) | length)",
        (kinds[] as $k | ($g | map(select(.kind == $k))) as $rows | select($rows | length > 0)
          | "",
            "## \($k) (\($rows | length))",
            "",
            "| id | class | status | origin | knob | floor | registrations |",
            "|----|-------|--------|--------|------|-------|---------------|",
            ($rows[] | "| \(.id | cell) | \(.class | cell) | \(.status | cell) | \(origin_txt | cell) | \(.knob | cell) | \(.floor | yesno) | \(regs) |"))
    ' <<<"$MAP_JSON"
}

render_hooks_block() {
    jq -r --argjson hooks "$HOOKS_JSON" "$JQ_DEFS"'
      (.guards | map({key: .id, value: .}) | from_entries) as $by
      | "<!-- guard-register:begin -->",
        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table from .claude/settings.json and .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml; do not edit by hand. Full register: grimoires/loa/guards.md -->",
        "| Event | Matcher | Script | Status | Knob | Purpose |",
        "|-------|---------|--------|--------|------|---------|",
        ($hooks[] | . as $h | $by[$h.id] as $r
          | "| \($h.event | cell) | \(if $h.matcher == "" then "(all)" else ($h.matcher | cell) end) | `\(if $h.wrapped then "hook-guard.sh " else "" end)\($h.id | ltrimstr("hook:") | cell)` | \($r.status | cell) | \($r.knob | cell) | \($r.note // "" | cell) |"),
        "<!-- guard-register:end -->"
    ' <<<"$MAP_JSON"
}

# Rewrites the marker block of $HOOKS_REF into $2 (exit 3 when the markers are absent or repeated).
render_hooks_ref() {
    local block="$1" dest="$2" nb ne
    [[ -f "$HOOKS_REF" && -r "$HOOKS_REF" ]] || die 3 "hooks reference not readable: $HOOKS_REF"
    nb="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    ne="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:end -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    [[ "$nb" == "1" && "$ne" == "1" ]] \
        || die 3 "$HOOKS_REF needs exactly one <!-- guard-register:begin --> and one <!-- guard-register:end --> line (found $nb and $ne)"
    awk -v blockfile="$block" '
      /^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$/ { while ((getline l < blockfile) > 0) print l; skip = 1; next }
      /^<!-- guard-register:end -->$/ { skip = 0; next }
      !skip { print }
    ' "$HOOKS_REF" > "$dest"
}

# Atomic replace: temp beside the destination, then rename.
install_file() {
    local src="$1" dest="$2" tmp
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
    tmp="$(mktemp "$(dirname "$dest")/.$(basename "$dest").XXXXXX")"
    cat "$src" > "$tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$tmp"
    mv -f "$tmp" "$dest"
}

render_register > "$REGISTER_NEW"
HOOKS_BLOCK="$TMPWORK/hooks-block.md"

        echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: drift: $OUT differs from the generated register" >&2
        diff -u "$OUT" "$REGISTER_NEW" 2>/dev/null | head -20 >&2 || true
        drift=1
    fi
    if ! cmp -s "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF"; then
        echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: drift: the guard-register table in $HOOKS_REF differs from the generated one" >&2
        diff -u "$HOOKS_REF" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" 2>/dev/null | head -20 >&2 || true
        drift=1
    fi
    if (( drift )); then
        echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: $REGEN_HINT" >&2

# Rewrites the marker block of $HOOKS_REF into $2 (exit 3 when the markers are absent or repeated).
render_hooks_ref() {

    nb="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    ne="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:end -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    [[ "$nb" == "1" && "$ne" == "1" ]] \
        || die 3 "$HOOKS_REF needs exactly one <!-- guard-register:begin --> and one <!-- guard-register:end --> line (found $nb and $ne)"

      /^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$/ { while ((getline l < blockfile) > 0) print l; skip = 1; next }

install_file() {
    local src="$1" dest="$2" tmp

--- a/evals/README.md
+++ b/evals/README.md
@@ -500,3 +500,33 @@ # arm A on the pre-change prompt tree (a worktree), arm B on the current tree, s
 `compare.sh` refuses a baseline whose `prompt_tree_sha` equals the tree under comparison, whose
 `captured_at_commit` is not a descendant of the suite's `ab.floor_commit`, or whose `corpus_sha256`
 drifted (`evals/tests/recall-baseline-freshness.bats`). Tests: `evals/tests/{execute-agent,eval-recall-grader,implement-discipline-grader,recall-baseline-freshness}.bats`.
+
+## Control arms and the record corpus (cycle-129 FR-2)
+
+Each recall suite pre-registers control arms in `ab.arms` (review: `baseline`, `no_companion`
+(informational), `no_karpathy`, `no_rule_files`; audit: `baseline`, `no_audit_delta`) and the verdict rule
+in `ab.threshold`. `execute-agent.sh` applies an arm (`LOA_EVAL_ARM`) to the sandbox copy only, after
+materialisation and immediately before the executor starts, and fails the trial (exit 2) when a toggle
+cannot take effect; `executor.json` records `arm`, `arm_toggles`, `arm_evidence`, `source_commit`,
+`models_used` and `refusal_fallbacks`. The executor never inherits the calling Claude Code session's
+coupling, and its subagent model is pinned to `EVAL_MODEL`.
+
+The record fixtures `pr-11` … `pr-18` are the round-1 states of sprints 247–254, built by
+`harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh` from `review-prs/record-pairs.tsv` and the `record/cycle-12x-a2a`
+branches. A feedback finding becomes a label only when the fix commit touches the file it cites. Labels
+live in the hidden `review-prs/labels/pr-NN.tsv` (never in the sandbox-copied `pr-NN/`), every drop is
+explained in `labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt`, and hand curation is the data file `labels/curation.tsv`,
+re-applied on every seed. `fix` rows (the hunks the fix commit changed) feed the grader's refuted share
+only. A label file is approved with `seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <date>"`;
+`run-arms.sh` refuses unapproved fixtures unless `--allow-unapproved`.
+
+```bash

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    53	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    54	EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
    55	CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
    56	DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
    57	CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
    58	# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
    59	# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
    60	SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
    61	
    62	SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
    63	CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
    64	DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
    65	
    66	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    67	die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    68	
    69	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    70	  case "$1" in
    71	    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
    82	    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
    83	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    84	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done

    88	# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
    89	case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
    90	[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"

   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}

     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch

   319	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>

   346	      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then

   373	    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \

   375	    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
   376	    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
   377	    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
   378	      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
   379	      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
   380	      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
   381	      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
   382	     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
   383	  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"

   386	keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
   387	  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
   388	  mkdir -p "$dest"
   389	  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do

   394	  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"

   397	
   398	# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
   399	collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
   400	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
   401	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
   402	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
   403	    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
   404	    set_state failed; exit 3
   405	  fi
   406	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
   407	    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"

   409	    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then

   411	      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   412	    else
   413	      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))

   415	    fi

   417	  else
   418	    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
   419	    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
   420	  fi
   421	  write_status
   422	}
   423	
   424	log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
   425	write_status

   427	
   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i
   431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
   432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
   433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
   434	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
   435	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
   436	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
   437	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
   438	        break
   439	      fi
   440	    done
   441	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
   442	  done
   443	  return 0
   444	}
   445	
   446	n=0
   447	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   449	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
   450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
   451	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
   452	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
   453	done
   454	reap 1
   455	
   456	total_done=0 total_failed=0
   457	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
   458	if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then

   460	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
   461	  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
   462	else
   463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
     3	
     4	Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
     5	suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
     6	<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
     7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
     8	
     9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
    10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
    11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
    12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
    13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
    14	the verdict and the missed labels.
    15	
    16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
    17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
    18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
    19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
    20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
    21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
    22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
    23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
    24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
    25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
    26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
    27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
    28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
    29	
    30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
    31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
    32	"""
    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40	
    41	
    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47	
    48	
    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id
   109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
   110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
   111	        self.cited = 0
   112	        self.refuted = 0
   113	        self.tokens = []
   114	        self.models = set()
   115	        self.sources = set()
   116	        self.done = 0
   117	        self.errors = 0
   118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
   119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
   120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
   121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
   122	
   123	    def add(self, row):
   124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
   125	            self.errors += 1
   126	            return
   127	        d = recall_details(row)
   128	        if d is None:
   129	            self.errors += 1
   130	            return
   131	        self.done += 1
   132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
   133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
   134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
   135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
   136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
   137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
   138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
   139	        t = tokens(row)
   140	        if t is not None:
   141	            self.tokens.append(t)
   142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
   143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
   144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
   145	            if out:
   146	                self.models.add(mid)
   147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
   148	        if fb:
   149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
   150	            for x in fb:
   151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
   152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
   153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
   154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
   157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   158	
   159	    def defect_fixtures(self):
   160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
   161	
   162	    def fixture_means(self):
   163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
   164	
   165	    def trial_means(self):
   166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
   167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
   168	            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
   169	                by_trial[t].append(r)
   170	        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
   171	
   172	    def refuted_share(self):
   173	        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
   174	
   175	
   176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
   177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
   178	    status = {}
   179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
   180	    if os.path.isfile(sp):
   181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   182	    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
   183	    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
   184	    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
   185	    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
   186	    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
   187	    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
   188	    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
   189	    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
   190	    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
   191	    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
   192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
   193	
   194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
   195	    arms = {}
   196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
   197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
   198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
   199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
   200	            continue
   201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
   202	        if m.get("dry_run"):
   203	            continue
   204	        manifests.append(m)
   205	        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
   206	        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
   207	            if a not in planned_arms:
   208	                planned_arms.append(a)
   209	            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
   210	            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
   211	                arm.add(row)
   212	    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
   213	    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
   214	    complete = state == "complete"
   215	
   216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
   217	    out_lines.append("")
   218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
   219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
   220	    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
   221	    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
   222	    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
   223	    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
   224	                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
   225	                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
   226	    out_lines.append("")
   227	
   228	    base = arms.get("baseline")
   229	    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
   230	    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
   231	    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
   232	    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
   233	    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
   234	
   235	    def coverage_gaps(arm):
   236	        gaps = []
   237	        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
   238	            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
   239	            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
   240	            if planted == 0:
   241	                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
   242	            if n < trials_required:
   243	                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
   244	        return gaps
   245	
   246	    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
   247	              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
   248	    out_lines.append(header)
   249	    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
   250	    details = []
   251	    verdicts = {}
   252	    for a in order:

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the two release-notes lines of a cycle, task-kind
     4	# counts and the volume ratio (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
     5	#
     6	#   kinds: mechanical N · judgment N · operator N
     7	#   volume: script lines changed N (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed N (*.md) · model calls N (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: <path>
     8	#
     9	# Mapping (the glossary's "Kind counts" and "Volume ratio" entries):
    10	#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /
    11	#                  '- [x]' task line under '### Technical Tasks', and each
    12	#                  '- [ ] Task ...' line under a '### Task N.E2E' heading, inside
    13	#                  a '## Sprint N' block of the sprint plan (fenced code skipped,
    14	#                  the same scope validate-artifact.sh --type sprint enforces);
    15	#                  untagged task lines are counted in --json and WARNed
    16	#   script lines   added + deleted lines of *.sh *.py *.ts *.js files between
    17	#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,
    18	#                  binary files skipped)
    19	#   prose bytes    bytes of the added and removed *.md lines between the two
    20	#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded
    21	#   model calls    MODELINV rows (primitive_id MODELINV) in the MODELINV log
    22	#                  whose ts_utc lies between the two commits' committer
    23	#                  timestamps, both ends included. The log is host-local, so
    24	#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
    25	#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
    26	#
    27	# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
    28	# default to paths under its top level.
    29	#
    30	# Usage:
    31	#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
    32	#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
    33	#
    34	#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md
    35	#   --modelinv PATH     default .run/model-invoke.jsonl
    36	#   --json              one JSON object instead of the two lines
    37	#
    38	# Exit 2 also covers: not a git repository, an unreadable sprint plan, jq missing.
    39	# Exit codes: 0 printed · 2 usage or unreadable input · 3 a SHA names no commit
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die() { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
    46	
    47	SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    48	FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"
    49	
    50	FROM=""
    51	TO=""
    52	PLAN=""
    53	MODELINV=""
    54	JSON=0
    55	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    56	  case "$1" in
    57	    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)
    58	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $1 needs a value" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    59	      case "$1" in
    60	        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
    61	        --to) TO="$2" ;;
    62	        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
    63	        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
    64	      esac
    65	      shift 2 ;;
    66	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    68	    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	
    72	[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    73	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"
    74	TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "not inside a git repository"
    75	[[ -n "$PLAN" ]] || PLAN="$TOP/grimoires/loa/sprint.md"
    76	[[ -n "$MODELINV" ]] || MODELINV="$TOP/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"
    77	[[ -r "$PLAN" && -f "$PLAN" ]] || die 2 "sprint plan not readable: $PLAN"
    78	[[ -r "$FENCE_AWK" ]] || die 2 "cannot read $FENCE_AWK (reinstall the framework scripts)"
    79	
    80	# A leading '-' would reach git as an option; a SHA never starts with one.
    81	case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac
    82	case "$TO" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $TO" ;; esac
    83	FROM_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${FROM}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM"
    84	TO_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${TO}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $TO"
    85	
    86	# --- kinds -------------------------------------------------------------------
    87	kinds="$(awk "$(cat "$FENCE_AWK")"'
    88	  md_fence($0) { next }
    89	  /^## / { insp = ($0 ~ /^## Sprint [0-9]/); sec = 0; next }
    90	  !insp { next }
    91	  /^### / {
    92	    sec = 0
    93	    if ($0 ~ /^### Technical Tasks[[:space:]]*$/) sec = 1
    94	    else if ($0 ~ /^### Task [0-9A-Za-z]+\.E2E([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)/) sec = 2
    95	    next
    96	  }
    97	  !sec || $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] / { next }
    98	  sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
    99	  {
   100	    if (match($0, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/)) {
   101	      v = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH)
   102	      sub(/^.*:[[:space:]]*/, "", v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", v)
   103	      n[v]++
   104	    } else n["untagged"]++
   105	  }
   106	  END { printf "%d %d %d %d\n", n["mechanical"], n["judgment"], n["operator"], n["untagged"] }
   107	' "$PLAN")"
   108	read -r K_MECH K_JUDG K_OPER K_UNTAGGED <<< "$kinds"
   109	[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2
   110	
   111	# --- volume ------------------------------------------------------------------
   112	GIT_DIFF=(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M)
   113	SCRIPT_LINES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --numstat "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.ts' '*.js' \
   114	  | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { s += $1 + $2 } END { printf "%d\n", s }')"
   115	PROSE_BYTES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --unified=0 "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.md' \
   116	  | awk '
   117	      /^diff --git / { hunk = 0; next }
   118	      /^@@ / { hunk = 1; next }
   119	      # the marker byte stands in for the newline the diff line drops
   120	      hunk && /^[+-]/ { s += length($0) }
   121	      END { printf "%d\n", s }
   122	    ')"
   123	
   124	# --- model calls -------------------------------------------------------------
   125	FROM_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$FROM_SHA")"
   126	TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"
   127	MODEL_CALLS=""
   128	if [[ -f "$MODELINV" && -r "$MODELINV" ]]; then
   129	  MODEL_CALLS="$(jq -R --argjson lo "$FROM_TS" --argjson hi "$TO_TS" '
   130	      fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .primitive_id == "MODELINV")
   131	      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring
   132	      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)
   133	      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)
   134	    ' "$MODELINV" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
   135	else
   136	  echo "WARN: MODELINV log not found at $MODELINV; model calls n/a" >&2
   137	fi
   138	
   139	iso() { jq -nr --argjson t "$1" '$t | todateiso8601'; }
   140	
   141	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   142	  jq -n \
   143	    --arg from "$FROM_SHA" --arg to "$TO_SHA" \
   144	    --arg from_ts "$(iso "$FROM_TS")" --arg to_ts "$(iso "$TO_TS")" \
   145	    --arg plan "$PLAN" --arg modelinv "$MODELINV" \
   146	    --argjson mech "$K_MECH" --argjson judg "$K_JUDG" --argjson oper "$K_OPER" --argjson untagged "$K_UNTAGGED" \
   147	    --argjson script_lines "$SCRIPT_LINES" --argjson prose_bytes "$PROSE_BYTES" \
   148	    --arg calls "$MODEL_CALLS" \
   149	    '{from: $from, to: $to, window: {from: $from_ts, to: $to_ts}, sprint_plan: $plan,
   150	      kinds: {mechanical: $mech, judgment: $judg, operator: $oper, untagged: $untagged},
   151	      volume: {script_lines_changed: $script_lines, prose_bytes_changed: $prose_bytes,
   152	               model_calls: (if $calls == "" then null else ($calls | tonumber) end),
   153	               scope: "host", modelinv: $modelinv}}'
   154	else
   155	  printf 'kinds: mechanical %s · judgment %s · operator %s\n' "$K_MECH" "$K_JUDG" "$K_OPER"
   156	  printf "volume: script lines changed %s (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed %s (*.md) · model calls %s (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: %s\n" \
   157	    "$SCRIPT_LINES" "$PROSE_BYTES" "${MODEL_CALLS:-n/a}" "$MODELINV"
   158	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# seed-corpus-from-record.sh — build a review-recall fixture from a shipped
     4	# sprint's round-1 state and its record-branch feedback (cycle-129 FR-2,
     5	# SDD D-2.2, DEC-0154)
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh <global-sprint> <record-ref> [--out <corpus>/pr-NN]
     9	#                              [--base <rev>] [--head <rev>] [--fix <rev>]
    10	#                              [--feedback a.md,b.md] [--dry-run]
    11	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --build-manifest pr-NN   # labels → hidden manifest (after curation)
    12	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <YYYY-MM-DD>"
    13	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --freeze                 # regenerate SHA256SUMS
    14	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check                  # verify SHA256SUMS
    15	#   common: [--repo <git dir>] [--corpus <evals/fixtures/review-prs>]
    16	#
    17	# Without --base/--head/--fix/--feedback/--out the sprint's row in
    18	# <corpus>/record-pairs.tsv supplies them.
    19	#
    20	# Writes (seed):
    21	#   <corpus>/pr-NN/{fixture.yaml, head.diff, PR.md, REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md,
    22	#                   AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, base/…, head/…}     (copied into the sandbox)
    23	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.tsv          HIDDEN (never copied into a sandbox): the labels,
    24	#                                      first line `# approved-by: pending`
    25	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt  HIDDEN: every finding that did not become a label, and why
    26	#   <corpus>/manifests/pr-NN.json      HIDDEN: the graded manifest (`approved: false` until --approve)
    27	#   <corpus>/corpus.tsv                one `record` row per fixture (or a `#` gap comment)
    28	#   evals/tasks/{review,audit}-recall/{review,audit}-pr-NN.yaml
    29	#   <corpus>/SHA256SUMS                refreshed
    30	#
    31	# Scope: the fixture is the change base..head without the generated or state
    32	# files (grimoires/, CHANGELOG.md, .claude/checksums.json, REPO-MAP.md, lock
    33	# files, .beads/, .run/, evals/results/) and without binaries.
    34	#
    35	# Label rule: a feedback finding becomes a label only when the fix commit
    36	# touches the file it cites (`git diff --name-only head..fix`) and that file
    37	# is part of the fixture; label_source is review (engineer-feedback*,
    38	# reviewer*), audit (auditor-sprint-feedback*) or bridgebuilder
    39	# (bridgebuilder*, the "Fixed" table only). The anchor is a head-side line
    40	# the fix changed near the cited line or inside the cited symbol; a finding
    41	# that cites only a file is anchored on that file's fix hunks when there are
    42	# at most four, else dropped. `fix` rows cover every hunk fix_commit changed
    43	# in a fixture file (source fix/<sha>:<start>-<end>); the grader uses them
    44	# only for refuted share. Titles are control-stripped, capped at 160 chars,
    45	# and a title matching a secret pattern drops its finding; every written
    46	# file passes evals/graders/no-secrets.sh or the seed fails.
    47	#
    48	# Exit: 0 ok, 1 refused / spec error / secret found / check failed, 2 usage
    49	# Tested by evals/tests/seed-corpus.bats.
    50	# =============================================================================
    51	set -euo pipefail
    52	export LC_ALL=C
    53	
    54	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    55	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    56	
    57	exec python3 -I - "$REPO_ROOT" "$@" <<'PY'
    58	import argparse, csv, hashlib, io, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
    59	
    60	HARNESS_ROOT = sys.argv[1]
    61	argv = sys.argv[2:]
    62	
    63	ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="seed-corpus-from-record.sh", add_help=True)
    64	ap.add_argument("sprint", nargs="?")
    65	ap.add_argument("record_ref", nargs="?")

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/guard-origins.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 AC-1.1, SDD D-1.6)
     5	# The origin map .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml covers every guard the
     6	# repository enumerates: every hook script registered in .claude/settings.json,
     7	# every fence pattern id in block-destructive-bash.sh, every validator rule
     8	# marker in validate-artifact.sh, the fixed gate list and the floor policies.
     9	# The enumeration here is independent of guard-yield.sh (its own jq/grep), so a
    10	# bug in the script cannot hide a gap. Fixture copies prove the failure modes.
    11	# =============================================================================
    12	
    13	# The sha256 of .claude/data/floor.yaml. An edit to the floor fails this suite
    14	# until the pin is updated deliberately, in the same change, with a reviewer:
    15	#   bash -c 'source .claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh; sha256_portable .claude/data/floor.yaml'
    16	FLOOR_SHA256="bd1f22dce9b6f18a0fda36d5a65dacd8103075c66c8c649b21de04fffcc92587"
    17	
    18	setup() {
    19	  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
    20	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    21	  GY="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh"
    22	  MAP="$ROOT/.claude/data/guard-origins.yaml"
    23	  FLOOR="$ROOT/.claude/data/floor.yaml"
    24	  SETTINGS="$ROOT/.claude/settings.json"
    25	  FENCE="$ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"

    27	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gorig.XXXXXX")"
    28	  # Fixture outputs never touch the tracked register or the live .run.
    29	  OUTARGS=(--out "$T/guards.md" --yield-dir "$T/run" --audit-log "$T/no-audit.jsonl")
    30	}
    31	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    32	
    33	# ids of every registered hook script, derived independently of guard-yield.sh
    34	enumerated_hook_ids() {
    35	  jq -r '.hooks | to_entries[] | .value[] | .hooks[].command' "$SETTINGS" \
    36	    | grep -oE '\.claude/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.sh' | sed -e 's#^\.claude/##' \

    41	    | sed -E 's/.*"([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)"$/fence:\1/' | sort -u
    42	}
    43	enumerated_validator_ids() {
    44	  grep -oE '^[[:space:]]*# @guard validator:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+' "$VALIDATOR" | sed -E 's/.*validator:/validator:/' | sort -u
    45	}

--- run-eval task enumeration

# --- PHASE: LOAD_SUITE ---
load_tasks() {
  TASK_FILES=()

  if [[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]]; then
    # Single task mode
    local task_file
    task_file="$(find "$TASKS_DIR" -name "${TASK_ID}.yaml" -o -name "${TASK_ID}.yml" | head -1)"
    if [[ -z "$task_file" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Task not found: $TASK_ID" >&2
      exit 3
    fi
    TASK_FILES=("$task_file")
    [[ -z "$SUITE" ]] && SUITE="single"
    log "[LOAD] Loaded single task: $TASK_ID"
    return
  fi

  if [[ -n "$SKILL" ]]; then
    # Skill filter mode
    while IFS= read -r -d '' task_file; do
      local task_skill
      task_skill="$(yq -r '.skill // ""' "$task_file")"
      if [[ "$task_skill" == "$SKILL" ]]; then
        TASK_FILES+=("$task_file")
      fi
    done < <(find "$TASKS_DIR" -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' | tr '\n' '\0')
    [[ -z "$SUITE" ]] && SUITE="skill-$SKILL"
    log "[LOAD] Found ${#TASK_FILES[@]} tasks for skill: $SKILL"

    # Read suite defaults
    SUITE_TRIALS="$(yq -r '.defaults.trials // 1' "$suite_file")"
    SUITE_TIMEOUT_TRIAL="$(yq -r '.defaults.timeout.per_trial // 120' "$suite_file")"
    SUITE_TIMEOUT_GRADER="$(yq -r '.defaults.timeout.per_grader // 30' "$suite_file")"
    SUITE_STRATEGY="$(yq -r '.defaults.composite_strategy // "all_must_pass"' "$suite_file")"

    log "[LOAD] Suite '$SUITE': ${#TASK_FILES[@]} tasks, ${SUITE_TRIALS} trial(s)"
    return
  fi

  # Default: run all tasks

    TASK_FILES+=("$task_file")
  done < <(find "$TASKS_DIR" -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' | sort | tr '\n' '\0')
  SUITE="all"
  log "[LOAD] Loaded ${#TASK_FILES[@]} tasks (all)"
